{White's b4 advance looks aggressive, but Black can get counterplay on the
long diagonal and reach a safe position. What should you play?} 10... Nfe4 {
[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a good way to exchange
knights.] [%hint Unblock your bishop and attack the c3-knight.]} (10... Nce4 $2
11. Ncb5 {Black has a hard time defending c7 and preventing the e4-knight from
getting trapped. Try again and look for a stronger knight move.}) (10... Ncd7
$2 11. Ncb5 {Black will have a hard time defending against a fork on c7. Try
again and look for a stronger knight move.}) (10... Na6 $2 11. Rb1 {The knight
is passive on a6 and White is doing well. Try again and look for a stronger
knight move.}) 11. Nxe4 {Good idea! How should you recapture?} Nxe4 {[%wrong
There's a better move. Try again and look for the strongest capture.] [%hint
Recapture and save your knight.] Well played! Black has good counterplay, with
an active knight and a powerful bishop on g7.} (11... fxe4 $2 12. bxc5 {
White wins material. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) (11... Bxd4
$2 12. Nxd6 {White emerges with a material edge. Try again and look for a
stronger capture.}) *

kingside. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.}) 9... Bxe6 {Good
idea! How should you start a strong attack?} 10. Nd4 {[%wrong There's a better
move. Try again and look for a useful threat.] [%hint Centralize a knight and

stronger to target the e6-bishop. How should you do it?}) (10. Nd5 $5 {This is
OK, but it's stronger to target the e6-bishop. How should you do it?}) *

{How should White break apart the black center?} 10. f3 {[%wrong There's a

Offer a trade for the e4-pawn.]} (10. e3 $5 {White is doing well, but it's
stronger to attack the black pawn center. How should you do it?}) 10... exf3 {
Nice move! How should you recapture?} 11. Nxf3 {[%wrong There's a stronger
move. Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Recapture and prepare to
bring your knight to e5.] Good work! White has a lead in development and the
better pawn structure.} (11. exf3 $2 Bf6 {Black has strong counterplay against
the d-pawn. Try again and look for a better capture.}) (11. Bxf3 $2 a5 {

and c1-bishop. Try again and look for a better capture.}) *

{It's rarely a good idea for Black to break the stonewall pawn structure to
capture on c4. How should White take advantage?} 7. Ne5 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try again and look for a way to target the c4-pawn.] [%hint
Centralize a knight and free your g2-bishop.]} (7. Qc2 $5 {White is doing well,
but there's an even stronger move to target the c4-pawn. How should you do it?}
) (7. Bg5 $5 {This is a good choice, but it's stronger to target the c4-pawn.
How should you do it?}) (7. Nbd2 $5 {White is doing well, but there's an even
stronger move to target the c4-pawn. How should you do it?}) (7. Na3 $2 Bxa3 {
Black trades off the knight, with only a slight disadvantage. Try again and
look for a better knight move.}) 7... b5 {Black attempts to hold the c4-pawn,
but White can still break down the black queenside. How should you do it?} 8.
a4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for the best way to
break apart the black queenside.] [%hint Attack b5 with a pawn.] Good work!
The c6 pawn is pinned and Black has no good way to defend the queenside.} (8.
Nxc6 $5 {This is OK, but it's stronger to target another pawn in Black's
queenside pawn chain. How should you do it?}) (8. Bg5 $5 {This is reasonable,
but it's better to target Black's queenside pawn mass. How should you do it?})
(8. e4 $5 {This is reasonable, but it's better to target Black's queenside
pawn mass. How should you do it?}) (8. Nc3 $5 {This is reasonable, but it's
better to target Black's queenside pawn mass. How should you do it?}) (8. b3 $5
{This is OK, but it's stronger to target another pawn in Black's queenside
pawn chain. How should you do it?}) *

{White typically aims to trade dark-squared bishops in the Stonewall Dutch,
but f4 isn't usually the way to do it. How should Black create counterplay?} 
7... Bxf4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Trade bishops.] White must recapture with the g-pawn and it
will be difficult for White's king to ever find safety.} (7... Be7 $2 8. Nbd2 {
White is doing well. Try again and look for a better bishop move.}) (7... Bb4
$2 8. Nbd2 {White is doing well. Try again and look for a better bishop move.})
(7... Bf8 $2 8. Nbd2 {White is doing well. Try again and look for a better
bishop move.}) (7... dxc4 $2 8. Bxd6 {White has more than enough compensation
for the sacrificed pawn. Try again and look for a better capture.}) *

{How can White force a useful exchange of bishops?} 9. Ba3 {[%wrong There's a
better move. Try again and look for a way to trade bishops.] [%hint Pin the
d6-bishop to the black queen.]} (9. a5 $5 {This is reasonable but the thematic
move is to force an exchange of bishops. How should you do it?}) (9. Qc2 $5 {
This is reasonable but the thematic move is to force an exchange of bishops.
How should you do it?}) (9. Bf4 $2 Bxf4 {White must weaken the kingside pawn
structure to recapture. Try to find a better way to trade bishops.}) 9... a5 {
Good start! What's next?} 10. Bxd6 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again
and look for a good capture.] [%hint Trade bishops before Black can play Bb4.]
Nicely done! Black has lost the most effective minor piece in the Stonewall
structure.} *

{How should Black take advantage of the pinned d4 pawn to comfortably finish
development?} 11... Nc6 {[%wrong There's a better developing move. Try to find
it.] [%hint Normally an early Nc6 gets attacked by d4-d5, but the d-pawn is
pinned now.]} (11... c5 $2 12. Qc2 {White will benefit from opening the center
with an edge in development. Try again.}) 12. Rad1 {Good move! White's last
move discourages e5. How can you make that move possible again?} Qe8 {[%wrong
There's a better move to promote e6-e5. Try to find it.] [%hint Get your queen
off the d-file so it's not lined up with the white rook.]} (12... Qe7 $5 {
That move helps you play e5, but there's a better spot for the queen. Try to
find it.}) (12... e5 $2 13. dxe5 {Your d-pawn is pinned, so White is better.})
13. Rfe1 {White is about to play e4, but Black can play in the center first.
How?} e5 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint Free your c8
bishop.] Well played! Black has a good position.} (13... d5 $2 14. Ne5 {
White is better, largely thanks to Black's bad bishop on c8. Try again.}) (
13... b6 $2 14. Qd2 {White is slightly better. Try to find a better move.}) (
13... Bd7 $2 14. Qd2 {The bishop is passive on d7. Try to find a better move.})

{What active response can Black play to fight against White's d5-break?} 9...
Nb4 {[%wrong You're going to lose your knight on c6. Try again.] [%hint Save
your knight with a forcing move.]} (9... exd5 $2 10. cxd5 {White's f3-knight
will be able to reach useful squares on d4 and e6. Try again.}) (9... Ne5 $2
10. Nd4 {Black will be unable to achieve the desired e6-e5. Try again.}) (9...
Nd4 $2 10. Nxd4 {Black loses a piece. Try again.}) (9... Na7 $2 {Black's
knight is passive on a7. Try to find a better knight move.}) (9... Nb8 $2 {
Black's knight is passive on b8. Try to find a better square for it.}) (9...
Nxd5 $2 10. cxd5 {White wins a piece. Try again.}) 10. Qb3 {Well played. How
can you achieve your ideal central pawn structure?} e5 {[%wrong That won't
achieve your ideal central pawn structure. Try again and look for a precise
pawn move.] [%hint Black wants a pawn phalanx on e5 and f5.] Black has good
development and will soon play f4 to start a kingside attack. Well done!} (
10... exd5 $2 11. cxd5 {White is better in this structure and it's hard to
create an attack. Try again.}) 0-1
